name: speech-recorder
description: Records your voice, transcribes it with a local AI model, and copies the text to your clipboard.

enumDescriptions: Fastest, least accurate · ~41 MB download from Hugging Face
Fast, fair accuracy · ~77 MB download from Hugging Face
Good balance of speed and accuracy · ~249 MB download from Hugging Face
Higher accuracy, slower, larger download · ~1.09 GB from Hugging Face
Use the Custom Model, Custom Dtype and Custom Revision settings below
anosicSpeech.model.markdownDescription: Speech model. Downloaded once on first use and cached (see `#anosicSpeech.modelCacheDir#`). Larger models are more accurate but slower to load and transcribe.

anosicSpeech.customModel.markdownDescription: Used only when `#anosicSpeech.model#` is **Custom**. Hugging Face id of an ONNX Whisper model, e.g. `Xenova/whisper-base.en` (English-only).

anosicSpeech.customDtype.markdownDescription: Used only when `#anosicSpeech.model#` is **Custom**. Weight variant to download; the model repo must publish it. `q8` (8-bit quantized) is the usual choice.

anosicSpeech.customRevision.markdownDescription: Used only when `#anosicSpeech.model#` is **Custom**. Model revision (commit sha or branch) to pin. Empty uses `main`.

anosicSpeech.modelCacheDir.description: Directory for downloaded model files. Empty uses the extension global storage.

anosicSpeech.captureBinary.description: Path to the speech-capture binary. Empty uses the bundled binary, or in a source checkout the Cargo target dir (release, then debug).

anosicSpeech.inputDevice.description: Input device name passed to speech-capture (`speech-capture --list-devices`). Empty uses the default.

anosicSpeech.noiseSuppression.description: Enable sonora noise suppression during capture.

anosicSpeech.autoGain.description: Enable sonora automatic gain control during capture.

anosicSpeech.autoClear.markdownDescription: Clear the transcript automatically some time after each transcription (see `#anosicSpeech.autoClearTimeoutMinutes#`), so dictated text is not left behind. Like **Clear**, it also empties the clipboard if it still holds the transcript; anything you copied since is left alone.

anosicSpeech.autoClearTimeoutMinutes.markdownDescription: Minutes after a transcription finishes before it is cleared. Used only when `#anosicSpeech.autoClear#` is on.

anosicSpeech.autoCopy.description: Copy the transcript to the clipboard as soon as transcription finishes.
